verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs explicitly describe entity-scoped memory that separates memories by user, agent, app, and session so 'memories land exactly where they belong,' directly matching the tenancy-isolation story (mem0-docs-9, mem0-docs-30). Self-hosted deployments also add per-user API keys and audit logs reinforcing tenant boundaries (mem0-docs-5, mem0-docs-22). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that isolation actually prevents cross-tenant leakage in practice, and no detail on access-control enforcement (e.g., can one user_id's key query another's memories) beyond docs claims.
